FAQ

Lilia questions, answered.

What is Lilia?

Lilia is a personal AI assistant for business owners. She works on WhatsApp and connects to your email and calendar to brief you, draft replies, book meetings and remind you of what matters.

Does Lilia send emails without asking me?

No. By default Lilia drafts and you approve with one tap. You can let her send routine replies automatically if you want.

Which email and calendar does Lilia work with?

Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook and Microsoft 365. Tell us if you use something else and we will confirm.

Is my data private?

Yes. Lilia only reads the accounts you connect, your data is used only to run your assistant, and you can disconnect at any time.

Can Lilia understand voice notes?

Yes. Send a voice note in Arabic or English and Lilia turns it into a task, a reply or a summary.

Can my team use Lilia too?

Scale covers the owner plus up to 4 assistants. Enterprise is for executive teams.

How long does setup take?

Setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call, and we agree the go-live date with you on that call.

How much does Lilia cost?

Starter, Growth and Scale have fixed monthly prices shown on this page, with a one-time setup fee on monthly plans. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise. Enterprise is quoted based on your volume and integrations.
